summary: Iteration 6 — Pipeline module (5-stage wizard + Finance handoff gate) + Space/Navigation BRD items. Backend: 16/16 pytest passed (login, pipeline CRUD with full BRD fields, advance, close Won/Lost, approve-handoff create-project-with-matching-po/customer/margin, reject without project, 400 on non-Won / already-processed, 403 for sales role, document name Query(..., min_length=1) mandatory with 422 when missing and persisted name returned via GET, dashboard top_customers<=10 + vendor_exposure<=10). Frontend: verified login, collapsible sidebar 256->64px persisting across reload, new nav entries (Pipeline, Change Requests, Customer Profile), Dashboard Revenue KPI (not 'Recognized Revenue'), 'Top 10 Suppliers', Pipeline page with KPIs + funnel + stage/flag/handoff badges + 'view project ->' on approved rows, 5-stage tabbed wizard with Stage 1-5 tabs clickable, '*' markers rendered on required fields (visible in both pipeline wizard and New Project modal), informational banner 'validation is not enforced yet', Change Requests page loads (h1='Change Requests'). Screenshots attached in /root/.emergent/automation_output.

minor.issue: Destructive full-document replace via PipelineIn.model_dump() — omitting any stage field resets it to the PipelineIn default (e.g. estimated_margin_pct resets to 0.0). Consider PATCH semantics or exclude_unset=True.

action_items: Optional: convert PUT /api/pipeline/{id} to a partial-update to avoid resetting unsent fields (minor).
Optional: add data-testid on pipeline wizard tabs (e.g. wizard-tab-stage-3) + opportunity-title-input + wizard-save-btn + documents-tab for more robust future automation. Not a functional bug.
critical_code_review_comments: PASS: approve-handoff correctly gated via require_role('finance','admin') (server.py L1633) — returns 403 for sales role (verified).
PASS: approve-handoff only allowed when outcome='Won' AND handoff_status='Pending Finance' — both guard clauses return 400 (verified for Open and Lost opportunities, and for already-approved).

PASS: On approval, project is created with po_value = negotiated_value or proposal_value or expected_revenue (L1657), customer_name/customer_id/business_category copied, margin_pct mirrors estimated_margin_pct; handoff_status set to Approved with handoff_project_id linked (verified via GET /api/projects/{pid}).
PASS: On reject, no project is created and handoff_status=Rejected (verified by comparing /api/projects count before/after).
PASS: POST /api/projects/{pid}/documents enforces name via Query(..., min_length=1) — 422 when missing, persisted on doc and returned by GET /api/projects/{pid}/documents.
PASS: GET /api/dashboard/summary returns top_customers[:10] and vendor_exposure[:10] (server.py L940,L951).
PASS: Pipeline seed data (4 opportunities) is idempotent and returned by GET /api/pipeline.
MINOR: server.py is now ~1806 lines (up from 1497). Router-level split into /routers/pipeline.py, /routers/dashboard.py, /routers/sap.py becomes important for maintainability.
MINOR: PUT /api/pipeline uses payload.model_dump() which replaces all PipelineIn fields; non-sent fields fall back to PipelineIn defaults (see minor backend issue).

NOTE: GET /api/pipeline/summary returns a flat shape ({funnel, total_opportunities, pending_handoff, total_value, ...}) rather than a nested totals object. Matches BRD intent; worth documenting in BRD doc.
